error.summary: Every default 2×2 radio question can be answered by selecting “No such entry” without reading the indices. This shortcut survived delivery in 33/33 sampled cases and the batch’s matching item. Package files remained unchanged.

source_analysis.skill: Interpret the first subscript as row and the second as column, check existence, and identify the indicated matrix entry.
reasoning_steps: Read the requested row and column.
Compare both indices with the square matrix’s order.
Return the intersecting entry or select “No such entry.”
invariants: Prompt, answer and solution refer to the same target.
permitted_variations: Matrix order 2–4, name, entries and target coordinates.
Existing and nonexistent targets within the same radio presentation and matrix size.
Choice positions and complete distractor banks.
source_refs: Tutorial 34f3a63d-a273-50fb-b26a-ae172c7e93e9: first subscript represents row; second represents column.
Tutorial 775ac64e-8b63-5c51-824d-1d99d17a2a0a: entries are defined within the matrix dimensions.

source_replay.details: Reconstructed six practice cases, complete banks and the canonical target. Missing source attributes were explicitly inferred. Historical raw R/E naming differs, but current learner output matches the supplied source.

math.details: 152 record checks independently verified prompt indexing, keys, option uniqueness and worked solutions; no failures.

variety.details: All six default bank profiles appeared, but construction reserves 2×2 radios for nonexistent entries. Valid existing-target counterfactuals are rejected.

scope.details: Requested easy samples preserve square orders 2–4 and direct lookup/existence reasoning.

grading.details: Native grader passed 86 checks, including equivalent numeric/radical entries, wrong answers and stale answers after relevant changes.

rendering.details: Twelve actual-UI previews rendered successfully; nine screenshots were visually inspected, including controlled pairs and radicals.

packaging.details: Dependencies match installed versions exactly. Deterministic replay, relocation and invalid-input rejection passed. All 98 package files remained unchanged.

decision_variation.details: Shape-only selection succeeds on 33/33 sampled 2×2 radios and 1/1 in the exact batch. All survived delivery. Selection cannot introduce absent counterexamples. Captured inventory contains only original source questions; no stored generated records were demonstrated defective.

findings.description: Default easy radio construction fixes the answer to “No such entry” whenever the matrix is 2×2. Learners can ignore the requested indices. Sampling forces existing radio profiles to larger matrices, while validation forbids existing targets in the 2×2 all_four profile.
findings.reproduction: Generate easy seed 11, profile all_four, parameters {"name":"B","matrix":[["1","-3"],["0","5"]],"i":3,"j":2}: answer is No such entry. Change only i to 2: expected answer 5, but generation raises ValueError. Run reproduce_restriction.py against the package entrypoint. Run python3 shortcut_regression.py --candidate-records delivery-sample/accepted.json --output shortcut-regression.json to reproduce 33/33 shape-only successes. Batch seed 3302362091 exhibits the same defect.
findings.requested_change: Decouple existence from matrix size and recognizable radio presentation. Permit existing and missing targets within the same size/layout groups, deriving banks and solutions consistently. Retain strict boundary-counterfactual and conditional-shortcut regressions, verify delivery, and regenerate through the deterministic package CLI. Changing seeds or editing runner-owned batch/database records does not repair this construction rule.
